# pantechdynamics_container_registry_namespace (Resource)

Your organization's namespace in the Pantech container registry: images are <registry_host>/<name>/<repository>:<tag>. An organization has exactly one namespace. Its name can change only while it holds no repository; after that a rename is refused (REGISTRY_NAMESPACE_LOCKED). A namespace cannot be deleted, so destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state. Only an API key made by an owner or admin can change it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Your organization's one namespace in the container registry. Images are
# <registry_host>/<name>/<repository>:<tag>. The name can change only while the
# namespace holds no repository, and a namespace cannot be deleted:
# `terraform destroy` only removes it from state.
resource "pantechdynamics_container_registry_namespace" "main" {
  name           = "acme"
  create_on_push = false # require repositories to be created first
}

output "registry_host" {
  value = pantechdynamics_container_registry_namespace.main.registry_host
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The namespace, globally unique: 3 to 30 characters, lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens, starting with a letter. Reserved words such as "library", "pantech" and "admin" are refused. Changing it renames the namespace in place, which changes every image path, and is refused once a repository has ever been created in it.

### Optional

- `create_on_push` (Boolean) Create a repository on the first push of an image to it. Defaults to true. With false, repositories must be created first (pantechdynamics_container_repository).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the namespace was claimed, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `id` (String) The namespace's name, which is also its id.
- `registry_host` (String) Host name of the registry, for docker login and image names, such as "registry.pantechdynamics.com".
- `repository_count` (Number) How many repositories the namespace holds.
- `repository_limit` (Number) The most repositories the namespace may hold.
- `storage_bytes` (Number) Storage used by the namespace's images, in bytes. Layers shared between images are counted once.
- `storage_limit_bytes` (Number) The most storage the namespace may use, in bytes. Pushes past it are refused (REGISTRY_STORAGE_LIMIT_REACHED).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The namespace is imported by its name, which must be your organization's.
terraform import pantechdynamics_container_registry_namespace.main acme
```
